    Print notes

    Head prints face-up with tree supports; 0.12–0.16 mm layers, 3 walls, petals are 1.2–1.4 mm thick. Stem prints lying flat (leaf side up) and plugs into the socket under the head. STL files are in the repo under rose3d/out/.
